Name: John the Baptist
Summary: John the Baptist was the prophesied forerunner who prepared the way for Jesus, baptising crowds in the Jordan and calling Israel to repentance. He baptised Jesus Himself and pointed his own disciples to the Lamb of God.
KeyStory: John declared of Jesus, Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world, and baptised Him as heaven opened.
RelatedPeople: Jesus; Elizabeth; Zechariah, Father of John the Baptist
LifeLesson: John's joy was to point away from himself: He must increase, I must decrease. A life that points others to Jesus is a life well spent, whatever its size.
